messages:
Ruth: Postmortem follow-up: three vendor-related cascades over the last month. Common failure chain: external auth rate-limit bursts -> model-registry returns 429/401 -> client retry storms + sticky-region pins stop failover. Need compact owners, short ETAs, and one verification gate to close these items.
Diego: ACK. Can we list the minimal fixes that unblock the cascade?
Ruth: Minimal fixes: (1) client: split 401 vs 429, cap concurrent refreshes, add jittered backoff, (2) routing: shorten sticky TTL + add explicit auth-error fallback to alternate region, (3) infra: synthetic 429-injection test + alert for retry storms, (4) vendor: SLA/support ask for throttle windows.
Arjun: I can take the client work. Plan: singleflight for token refresh + cap concurrent refreshes to 3, 401 -> immediate refresh path, 429 -> longer backoff with jitter. ETA: PR in 4 business days. Pseudo I'll use:```
// pseudo backoff
base=200ms
attempt++
if status==429 { wait=(base*2^attempt) + rand(0,base) + 1s }
else if status==401 { triggerRefresh(); wait=base /* single quick retry */ }
```
Liam: I'll own vendor comms: open SR, request historical rate-limit windows and a prioritized contact. ETA: 7 business days.
Maya: I'll own the postmortem follow-up doc and dashboard card linking the 3-event cluster. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Diego: I'll own routing: lower sticky-routing TTL to 20s for model-registry flows and add explicit alternate-region failover on auth errors. Plan a 10% canary for 48h. ETA: 6 business days.
infra-bot: Creating synthetic job template "auth-429-storm-test" in staging. Will run daily and emit PASS/FAIL + SLO drift to #incidents. ETA: 3 business days.
Ruth: Action items summary (tracking):
- I1: Arjun -> client PR + integration tests (due: 4 business days)
- I2: Liam -> vendor SR + summary (due: 7 business days)
- I3: Diego -> routing TTL change + canary plan (due: 6 business days)
- I4: infra -> synthetic job + alert rule (due: 3 business days)
- I5: Maya -> update postmortem + dashboard card (due: EOD tomorrow)
Maya: Add security quick-check: ensure singleflight/prefetch doesn't leak token scopes or extend expiry. I'll ask security to do a 30m review.
Arjun: noted. I'll include unit tests that simulate 429 bursts and assert backoff behavior.
Liam: SR opened: SR-81023. Will paste vendor reply into the follow-up doc when available.
infra-bot: Reminder: I1 due in 4 business days.
Ruth: Can we do a 30m check-in in 72h to confirm PRs and SR updates? Keep thread quiet and use the follow-up doc for details.
Ruth: @calendar-bot schedule check-in in 72h, 30m.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Vendor Chain Hardening Check" Fri Oct 18 09:30am PT. Invite: Ruth, Diego, Maya, Liam, Arjun.
Diego: Will draft canary telemetry queries and rollback criteria into the follow-up doc.
Maya: I'll publish the dashboard card and tag the postmortem doc. Closing thread; updates in the doc. :thumbsup:
